title: Underlying quotient section tensor comparison
statement: For fixed normalized scalar section data and normalized tensor data, the underlying quotient section tensor comparison is nonempty before its normalization equations.

proof.text: Use the fixed derived section equivalences e and e′ and their tensorComparison isomorphisms from def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data. Write B and B′ for the internal derived tensors, S and S′ for the section tensors, F for internal scalar extension and G for c.model.T. Then tensorComparison gives B followed by e.functor isomorphic to (e.functor.prod e.functor) followed by S, and similarly for the primed coefficients.

Construct a natural isomorphism after precomposition by e.functor.prod e.functor. Starting from that product followed by S followed by G, apply the inverse first tensor comparison, then c.derived.symm, then the given internal tensor isomorphism b, then the second tensor comparison, and finally the product of c.derived with itself. Functor associators and whiskering identify the endpoint with (e.functor.prod e.functor) followed by (G.prod G) followed by S′. This is the explicit calc in the proved private tensor_iso_transport helper; no normalization equations or representative choices occur.

The product equivalence e.prod e is an equivalence. Precomposition with its functor is therefore fully faithful, by the Mathlib whiskering-left equivalence instance. Apply its preimageIso to the preceding natural isomorphism, obtaining S followed by G isomorphic to (G.prod G) followed by S′, and package it in Nonempty.

theorem section_tensor_transport_normalized_barB_exists (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)

        (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T)
